title: Sneak Away and Listen to Me
description:
Does this sound like a familiar scenario?Sneaking away for a few minutes just to hear my voice…

I made a special series of short audio clips you can listen to throughout the day, so my voice, and its effect on your mind and body, never has to wear off.

And because I can’t help myself... I added a little delicious homewrecking too.
author: Goddess Nichole
